# SetSamplerAddressModeU <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SetSamplerAddressModeU:Void sampler:Int32, mode:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sampler` | In | Int32 | required | The sampler to change. |
| `mode` | In | Int32 | required | The address mode from the table above. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Chooses what is read where the horizontal texture coordinate (u) is not between 0 and 1. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals read every texture with the settings of its flags and do not have samplers.

| Mode | Result |
|---|---|
| 0 | Repeat: the texture starts again, the default. |
| 1 | Mirror: every second repeat is turned around. |
| 2 | Clamp: the edge texel is stretched out. |
| 3 | Border: the color of [SetSamplerBorderColor](SetSamplerBorderColor), opaque black by default. |

[SetSamplerAddressModeV](SetSamplerAddressModeV) does the same for the vertical coordinate (v), and [SetSamplerAddressModeW](SetSamplerAddressModeW) for the depth coordinate (w), which flat textures do not use.

## Differences

* The mode has to be 0 to 3, other values stop the program with an error. Mirror once (the coordinate is mirrored and then clamped) is not offered, since not every graphics card can do it.
